TextBlock.Text: THEATRE Banda approaches
DATE 30 October 2028 · 0230 local
SIDE Royal Australian Navy
WINDOW 45 min, closes at 68
KJ-500. Photo: see PHOTO_CREDITS.txt · CC BY-SA 4.0 · cropped
"Saying so, unfortunately, does not make it true; and if true, saying so does not always make it believed."
- Thomas C. Schelling

BANDA APPROACHES, middle watch. Something small and low is running south out of the Seram passage with almost no freeboard and no transponder. It may be carrying weapons for the airfield-and-port enclave Meridian's hard-liners still hold, it may be carrying people, and the difference decides what you are allowed to do about it.

Your ship is working this water, with your Seahawk and Poseidon if you have them to fly. There is also a real submarine in this water - a Type 039 that has been quiet for eleven hours - and a biologic contact that three different ships have now reported as a hostile boat.
Classify the craft - the passenger - then track it into the handover box to the south. Classify what else is down there. Do not lose the ship doing it.
Commodore Alex Mercer
COMMANDER'S INTENT

Classify the craft, then walk it into the handover box. Do not sink it: what it is carrying is evidence, and where it is going is the hard-liners' supply route. The submarine and the whale will both want your attention. Only the craft matters tonight.
• Classify the low-profile craft, then walk it into the handover box
• Keep your flagship afloat
• Do not shoot the wildlife or the fishermen

Your patrol group, and your MH-60R and P-8A if you have them. In the water: a low-profile craft, a Type 039, a fishing boat and one very large mammal. Overhead, for a foreign military: a KJ-500 early-warning aircraft, a Ka-28 and a spotter drone.

The planned window is 45 minutes. At that minute Command signals that you are behind schedule and holds the line for about 23 minutes more; the operation is closed at 68 minutes and the main task will be recorded as failed.
RULES OF ENGAGEMENT
All designated neutral contacts are protected. A protected neutral loss cancels the operation. Identify before you shoot.
